svg.desc: Requirement diagram generated from the SysML v2 model, one per function: its system requirements with the stakeholder need each is derived from (WP-S-01 §1.3), the elements that satisfy them from WP-S-01 §10.1, and the verification cases of the test specifications that name them; requirements no case names are outlined red.
svg.text: V-06 · Requirement diagram · F-01 lateral control
SYS requirements of WP-S-01 with the needs they refine (§1.3), the elements that satisfy them (§10.1) and the cases that verify them
While lateral control is active on a straight or curved road inside the ODD,
the system shall keep the vehicle near the lane centre.
type P · verif LOG, T-VEH · target Lateral offset from lane centre: p95 ≤ TBD (proposed 0.3 m), p9…
«deriveReqt» from SN-01: Less effort keeping the car in its lane on a highway, while staying in ch…
The commanded lateral acceleration shall not exceed 3.0 m/s²
(roll-compensated) and the lateral jerk shall not exceed 5 m/s³.
type C · verif T-SIL · target as stated
«deriveReqt» from SN-01: Less effort keeping the car in its lane on a highway, while staying in ch…
The system shall follow curves down to the radius R_ODD = v²/2.5 m/s² at
the travel speed without saturating the steering command.
type P · verif T-VEH, LOG · target No steerSaturated in curves ≥ R_ODD in ≥ TBD % of passes
«deriveReqt» from SN-01: Less effort keeping the car in its lane on a highway, while staying in ch…
When the steering command saturates, the system shall warn the driver
type H · verif T-SIL · target Warning within ≤ 1 s of saturation
«deriveReqt» from SN-06: Knowing at all times whether the assistance is on, and why it asks the…
An assisted lane change shall start only after the driver activates the turn
signal and applies steering torque in the same direction, above 20 mph.
type F · verif T-SIL · target as stated
«deriveReqt» from SN-02: Help with a lane change, but only when the driver asks for it
An assisted lane change shall complete or be cancelled within 10 s of the
turn signal; it shall be cancelled when the turn signal is released.
type F · verif T-SIL · target 10 s
«deriveReqt» from SN-02: Help with a lane change, but only when the driver asks for it
Lateral control shall not be active at standstill and shall resume without a
steering jump when the vehicle moves off.
type F · verif T-SIL · target Torque change at resume within TSR-103 rate
«deriveReqt» from SN-01: Less effort keeping the car in its lane on a highway, while staying in ch…
Lateral control shall not cause oscillation (weaving) on a straight road.
type P · verif LOG, T-VEH · target Lateral offset spectral peak 0.2–2 Hz below TBD
«deriveReqt» from SN-01: Less effort keeping the car in its lane on a highway, while staying in ch…
verifies SYS-001, SYS-002, SYS-003, SYS-004, SYS…
